discovery: Installed backtesting.py0.6.6 Position.pl_pct returns (position.pl / initial_position_value)*100, while Trade.pl_pct uses a fraction. The inherited Arz adapter compared Position.pl_pct <= -0.05 but described a5%position stop. Its actual close-trigger threshold was -0.05%, not -5%. Gaps can still produce larger losses.
evidence: Read the installed property source and traced baseline exit attribution: most small losing trades were labeled position_stop. Both old and initial new adapters reproduced this inherited behavior exactly; accounting tests did not detect the unit mismatch.
affected_scope: All prior external-engine experiments using FixedSignals.position.pl_pct threshold; not necessarily the separate standard-library Arz engine. Preserve old files and numbers as actual legacy behavior, but do not treat them as results of a5%stop policy.

initial_batch_preserved.classification: LEGACY_UNIT_CONFOUNDED_ABLATION; not accepted evidence that ATR alone improves the intended5%baseline

correction: Normalize Position.pl_pct by100 at the new adapter boundary. Keep sharedPolicy stop threshold -0.05 as a fraction. Preserve a clearly labeled legacy_units=True audit path solely to reproduce old ledgers; default new studies use correct units. ATR variants already use native price stops and must not be retrospectively blamed for or credited with the inherited channel-stop bug. Paper uses fractional price change and becomes consistent with the corrected adapter.
research_constraints: Do not add strategies, alter cost/windows/risk settings or optimize parameters. Rerun exactly the same9configurations and selection formula; retained nine-candidate budget unchanged. Publish both result versions and quantify the correction. Corrected selection is still seen-data diagnostic, NOT a new independent holdout because first-batch evaluation was already read.
verification_required: Assert every adapter position-return input equals price/entry-1 in synthetic active trades
Show explicit legacy mode still matches old ledgers
Test that a1%loss is -0.01 at the shared-policy boundary rather than -1
Repeat paper/backtest return convention and immutableR checks
Keep old results and source snapshots; no overwrite of earlier phase evidence
R_caveat: Initial first-batch R0 used intended5%risk while actual legacy channel trigger was0.05%; first-batch netR must not be interpreted as realized multiples of the effective legacy trigger. Corrected-run R0 reflects the implemented5%signal definition, still not guaranteed maximum loss.
financial_decision: NO-GO; no signed transaction, capital or live service
